Formula 1 will return to V8 engines from 2030 in a move FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem has described as "an opportunity to reconnect with the DNA" of the sport.

Earlier this week, Ben Sulayem teased the possibility of V8 engines ahead of the Las Vegas Grand Prix, live on Sky Sports F1, with the sound of a screaming F1 car with a caption: "You spoke, we listened. V8s coming soon."

On Friday, the FIA announced a technical framework had been unanimously agreed between the FIA, Formula One Management (FOM), the teams and Formula 1 power unit manufacturers to move to a 2.1-litre turbocharged V8 power unit.

The agreement means the more popular V8s will make a comeback in 2030, 17 years after the sport abandoned them in favour of "road relevant" engines, a decision already backed by several drivers.

The current power unit, which is around 53 per cent electrically powered, has been criticised by some drivers this year as it has led to an unusual style of driving and racing at some tracks, with the drivers sometimes unable to push flat out in a traditional manner.

"This agreement marks a significant milestone in shaping the future of Formula 1," said Ben Sulayem.
"From the outset I have been clear in my ambition to deliver a sport that is more competitive and more exciting for our fans, while remaining at the forefront of innovation and sustainability.

"The return of V8 engines represents an opportunity to reconnect with the DNA of this Championship, bringing back the sound, emotion and pure racing that is loved worldwide. Our vision is clear, lighter, simpler and more affordable cars that put driver skill at the heart of the competition."

Verstappen: F1 going in the right direction

Max Verstappen has been one of the most vocal critics of the new 2026 power units and warned the long straights in Las Vegas this weekend will be "painful" to drive on as the cars will effectively slow down before the braking zone.

Verstappen feels the FIA have listened to the drivers and realised the 2026 regulations are "not what you want" and, if he was in charge, would get rid of the turbo aspect completely and effectively have a fully normally aspirated engine.
"In some tracks then you're not allowed to race because it will be too loud because if it's up to me I would take the turbo off," he explained.

"I would get rid, maybe you can use it as a push to pass, but not too much of the battery side. But then on some tracks, you're not allowed to race, so fuel consumption goes up a lot without a turbo, so you need a bigger tank if you don't want to do refuelling in the races, so I understand that you want to have a turbo.

"If it's fully up to me, of course you go back to like a V10 or whatever. That sounds even better, but I know that not something realistic. This [news] is good. This is for sure in the right direction."
Max Verstappen admitted in August, with V8 engines' potential return in 2030, there may be another opportunity for him to reassess his future in F1
Lewis Hamilton, Fernando Alonso, Nico Hulkenberg Sergio Perez and Valtteri Bottas are the only drivers who drove in the previous V8 era which ended in 2013.

Most of the grid have driven V8-powered F1 cars in demonstration of show runs at fan events and Mercedes driver George Russell says it's important for a hybrid element to remain so the cars can have over 1,000 brake horsepower.
"When I look at the old videos of the old engines, they give me goosebumps," said Russell.

"It's about just that high-pitched squeal that I'm missing from this era. The purists will say take away all electrical power, but I think when you look at how a lot of these cars have evolved in recent years, and the power output from some of these electrical motors these days, Formula 1 is going to continue to be the fastest race cars on the planet, you need to have it, that's just the reality.
"You need to have some sort of hybrid, because the power you get, you can't really produce that just solely on internal combustion."

国际汽联宣布，管理机构、F1管理层与动力单元制造商已达成一致，F1因此距离2030赛季回归V8引擎更近一步。
F1长期致力于为从2031年开始的下一轮规则周期打造更便宜、更简单的引擎，因为其已认识到当前动力单元过于复杂、物理重量偏大，是公路汽车行业另一发展方向的遗留产物。
国际汽联本可以将该系列赛未来的动力单元法规设定在2031年，即当前周期结束时，但这项运动内部已广泛达成一致，将这一时间表提前一年，推动者包括主席穆罕默德·本·苏拉耶姆和F1首席执行官斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利。
因此，在F1委员会和动力单元咨询委员会最近的会议之后——会上讨论了方程式、时间表和成本等关键方面——各方广泛支持将下一代引擎法规提前一年，并缩短当前法规的期限。共识是F1转向2.1升涡轮增压V8引擎，搭配200千瓦的较小电动组件，其中一半将专门保留用于超车模式。
2.1升的排量是以当前1.6升V6方程式为起点推导而来，增加两个气缸旨在降低开发成本。
在周二宣布计划流产之后，国际汽联现已正式确认，其利益相关方一致支持将这一转变提前至2030年。
国际汽联周五表示：“国际汽联公布了将于2030年引入的F1动力单元规则，选用2.1升涡轮增压V8作为动力单元，并沿用部分几何规格。”
“首要目标是提供一种比当前动力单元简单得多、更轻且更便宜的动力单元。它将采用有限的混合动力技术，即相关且可持续的技术，旨在提升进攻性赛车风格以及让车迷产生共鸣的声浪。”
“此外，计划是将V8动力单元与同样更轻、更灵活、更强调车手技术和近距离竞争的底盘相结合。”
本·苏拉耶姆补充道：“这项协议标志着塑造一级方程式未来的一个重要里程碑。”
“从一开始，我就明确表达了我的雄心：为车迷打造一项更具竞争力、更激动人心的运动，同时始终站在创新与可持续发展的前沿。”
“V8引擎的回归代表着一个重新连接这项锦标赛DNA的机会，带回全世界所喜爱的声浪、情感和纯粹的赛车。”
“我们的愿景很明确：更轻、更简单、更实惠的赛车，让车手技术成为竞争的核心。”
2030年动力单元规则仍需世界汽车运动理事会和动力单元制造商正式投票通过，包括动力单元成本上限确切水平在内的若干细节仍有待商定。
detailEn: Formula 1 set for V8 turbo return in 2030
The FIA says there is unanimous support for a 2.1-litre turbocharged V8 with reduced hybrid power, although the regulations still require formal approval

Formula 1 has moved closer to a return to V8 engines from the 2030 season as the FIA announced that a unanimous agreement has been reached between the governing body, F1 management and the power unit manufacturers.

F1 has long worked towards cheaper and simpler engines for the next regulation cycle, which starts in 2031, having recognised the current formula is too complex and physically heavy, and a relic of a different direction in the road car industry.

The FIA could have set the series’ future power-unit regulations for 2031, when the current cycle ends, but there has been broad alignment within the sport to bring that timeline forward by one year, driven by both president Mohammed Ben Sulayem and F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali.

So following recent gatherings by the F1 Commission and power unit advisory committee, where key aspects like the formula, timelines and costs were discussed, there had been broad support to bring forward the next generation of engine regulations by one year and curtail the current formula. The consensus is for F1 to move to a 2.1-litre turbocharged V8 engine with a smaller electric component of 200kW, half of which will be ringfenced for overtake-mode use.
The 2.1-litre capacity is derived from the current 1.6-litre V6 formula as a starting point, with two additional cylinders intended to reduce development costs.
After an aborted announcement on Tuesday, the FIA has now officially confirmed there is unanimous support among its stakeholders about bringing that move forward to 2030.

"The FIA presented F1 Power Unit regulations for introduction from 2030 with a 2.1 litre turbocharged V8 as the power unit of choice carrying over some geometrical specifics," the governing body said on Friday.

"The overriding objective is to deliver a power unit which is a lot less complex, lighter and cheaper than the current power units. It will feature limited hybridisation, relevant and sustainable technology with the aim of enhancing attack-oriented racing and a sound which resonates with fans.
"Additionally, the plan is to marry the V8 power unit to a chassis which will also be lighter, more agile and placing greater emphasis on driver skill and close racing. "
Ben Sulayem added: "This agreement marks a significant milestone in shaping the future of Formula 1.
“From the outset I have been clear in my ambition to deliver a sport that is more competitive and more exciting for our fans, while remaining at the forefront of innovation and sustainability.
"The return of V8 engines represents an opportunity to reconnect with the DNA of this championship, bringing back the sound, emotion and pure racing that is loved worldwide.
“Our vision is clear, lighter, simpler and more affordable cars that put driver skill at the heart of the competition."

The 2030 power unit rules still need to be formally voted through by the World Motor Sport Council and by the power unit manufacturers, with a number of finer details, including the exact level of the power-unit cost cap, still to be agreed.

detailZh: 根据《福布斯》2026年报告，F1车队价值从2025年的36亿美元跃升至2026年的52亿美元。
报告显示，法拉利以95亿美元位居价值榜首位，梅赛德斯以92亿美元位居第二，这两家车队与NFL顶级球队、NBA最值钱的球队以及皇家马德里队价值相当。
F1的11支车队因此平均价值为52亿美元，如果不包括缺席2025年排名的凯迪拉克，平均价值达到54亿美元，比去年增长53%。
哈斯车队价值增长87%，从15亿美元增至28亿美元，而迈凯轮的价值增长了73%，达到76亿美元。
福布斯将预估收入作为其计算的一部分：从2024年到2025年，预估收入增长了15%，每支车队达到5.3亿美元。
报告称，迈凯轮和梅赛德斯-奔驰预计将在2026年首次突破10亿美元——只有NFL的达拉斯牛仔队以及足球队伍皇家马德里和巴塞罗那达到过这个水平。
报告强调“倍数”是F1车队增长的动力：2019年，F1车队的估值是其上一赛季收入的2.3倍，而10支车队（不包括凯迪拉克）的平均估值是去年收入的10.3倍。
这标志着过去七年F1车队商业模式的转变，意味着F1车队的价值与它们巨大的增长潜力相关，而不是实物资产和历史现金流。
拥有一支一级方程式车队的股份因此被比作拥有一支有价值的美国体育俱乐部，因为一级方程式车队的收入倍数现在正接近NFL和NBA，并且远远超过NHL、MLB和欧洲足球。
根据《福布斯》杂志，收入倍数的上升是2021年成本上限（2026年为2.15亿美元）的结果，这一上限限制了支出。
成本上限加上康科德协议，使得法拉利、红牛、小红牛、梅赛德斯-奔驰、哈斯和阿尔派在2025年实现了盈利——预计麦克拉伦在2026年的利润将达到2亿美元。
据估计，梅赛德斯-奔驰的利润最高，达到2.25亿美元。
在赛道上只有11支车队的情况下，能够拥有一支F1车队的一部分是非常罕见的。体育新闻网站Sportico在11月报道，马克·沃尔特的凯迪拉克股份至少以30亿美元的价格出售。
自由媒体CEO德里克·张最近表示，F1在美国取得了“巨大进展”，这是其持续关注的领域，而中国和印度“代表着F1和MotoGP的机会”。
到2027年，梅赛德斯-奔驰和法拉利的价值预计将达到100亿美元。
在这里拉斯维加斯实地考察，福布斯报道的F1车队平均价值47%的增长对我来说并不意外。
我本周将与Liberty Media首席执行官Derek Chang进行一次采访，在《赛车商业》杂志上，听他谈论时，你能感受到管理这项赛事的人们对美国前景的乐观情绪。漫步在这座城市中，你就能理解为什么了。
今年我参加了所有的三场美国大奖赛。在迈阿密和奥斯汀，确实感受到了一股商业热潮，但在这里的拉斯维加斯，感觉就像达到了高潮。就像拉斯维加斯的大部分事物一样。
我与的团队商业总监们交谈时，他们几乎被这种兴趣所淹没。他们在四处寻找维修区通行证，或者试图把更多的人塞进Paddock Club。无论你去哪里，都能看到品牌活动。美国公司几乎是在往一级方程式上砸钱。
看看F1自己在三天内宣布了什么。渣打银行升级了其合作伙伴关系。耐克签约了。Whoop也签约了。谁能想到，就在几年前，F1的赞助名单上会有可穿戴设备这一类别？这个系列正处于健康发展的状态。
在六月的摩纳哥赛事中，阿斯顿·马丁的杰弗森·斯莱克问道：“我们的估值是收入六到七倍。为什么一支NBA球队的估值是收入十二倍？”《福布斯》现在将10支已建立的F1车队估值平均为收入10.3倍。从这个角度来看，杰夫看到的差距已经大部分缩小了。
我们应该给这些个别数字多少权重？《福布斯》和《体育ico》相隔八天发表，仅法拉利一项就相差13亿美元。在赛季间歇期，我们将重新审视我们对车队所有权和估值的分析，并查看这两份报告背后的假设与人们实际达成的交易相比如何。
或许争夺传球权是一个不错的衡量争夺所有权的指标。只有11支车队，但你通常还能找到一支更多的传球。如果传闻中的阿尔卑斯或凯迪拉克的股份出售在圣诞节前完成，我们可能会得到一个明确的数据点，了解现在永久进入的成本。
detailEn: The value of each Formula 1 team has jumped 47% from $3.6billion USD in 2025 to $5.2bn in 2026 according to Forbes' 2026 report.

The report puts Ferrari highest at $9.5bn to Mercedes's $9.2bn, putting those two most valuable F1 teams on par with the top half of the NFL's teams, the three most valuable NBA teams, and Real Madrid.
F1's 11 teams are therefore valued at an average of $5.2bn and, not including Cadillac - which was absent from the 2025 rankings - the average is up to $5.4bn, a gain of 53% from last year.
Haas has made the largest increase in value - of 87%, from $1.5bn to $2.8bn - while McLaren's value has increased 73% to $7.6bn. Scroll down to view the full valuations table.
Forbes uses estimated revenue as part of its calculations: from 2024 to 2025, estimated revenue rose 15% to $530m per team.

Its report says that McLaren and Mercedes expect to surpass $1bn for the first time ever in 2026 - and only the NFL's Dallas Cowboys and football teams Real Madrid and Barcelona have reached that mark.

The report highlights “multiples” as a catalyst for F1 teams' growth: in 2019, F1 teams were valued at 2.3 times their previous season's revenue and the 10 teams (excluding Cadillac) are now valued at 10.3 times last year's revenue on average.

This signals a transformation of F1 teams' business models over the last seven years, implying that the value of an F1 team is tied to their huge potential for growth rather than physical assets and historic cashflow.

Owning a stake of an F1 team is therefore likened to owning that of a valuable US sports franchise, with F1 teams' revenue multiples now closing in on the NFL and NBA - and well ahead of the NHL, MLB, and European football.
The upswing in multiples is, according to Forbes, a consequence of the 2021 cost cap (at $215m for 2026) that limited spending.
The cost cap, plus Concorde Agreements, have led Ferrari, Red Bull, Racing Bulls, Mercedes, Haas, and Alpine to be profitable in 2025 - with McLaren expected to hit a profit of $200m in 2026.
Mercedes is estimated to have the highest profit of $225m.
With just 11 teams on the grid, it's rare to be able to own a piece of an F1 team. Sportico reported in November that Mark Walter's stake in Cadillac is being offered for at least $3bn.

Liberty Media CEO Derek Chang recently said that F1 has made “huge inroads” into the United States, a continued area of its focus, while China and India “represent opportunities” both for F1 and MotoGP.
In 2027, the values of Mercedes and Ferrari are projected to hit $10bn.
Being on the ground here in Las Vegas, it's no surprise to me that Forbes is reporting a 47% increase in the average value of a Formula 1 team.

I've been talking to Liberty Media CEO Derek Chang for an upcoming interview in The Race Business this week and listening to him you get a sense of how buoyant the people running the championship feel about its prospects in America. Walk through the city and you can understand why.
I've been to all three US grands prix this year. There was a real commercial buzz in Miami and Austin, but here in Vegas it feels like it's reaching fever pitch. As most things do in Vegas.

The team commercial directors I've spoken to are almost overwhelmed by the interest. They're scrabbling around for paddock passes or trying to squeeze one more prospect into the Paddock Club. Everywhere you go there's a brand event. American companies are practically throwing money at Formula 1.

Look at what F1 itself announced in three days. Standard Chartered upgraded its partnership. Nike signed up. So did Whoop. Who would have imagined, even a few years ago, that there'd be a wearables category on F1's sponsorship list? The series is in rude health.

At our Monaco event in June, Aston Martin's Jefferson Slack asked “We're valued at six or seven times revenue. Why is an NBA team valued at 12 times revenue?” Forbes now puts the 10 established F1 teams at an average of 10.3 times revenue. On that measure, much of the gap Jeff saw has already closed.

How much weight should we put on the individual numbers? Forbes and Sportico published eight days apart and disagreed by $1.3bn on Ferrari alone. Over the off season we'll revisit our work on team ownership and valuations and look at how the assumptions behind both reports stack up against the deals people have actually done.

Perhaps the scrabble for passes is a decent KPI for the scrabble for ownership. There are only 11 teams and yet you can usually find one more pass. If either of the rumoured Alpine or Cadillac stake sales gets over the line before Christmas, we might get a firm data point of what it now costs to get in permanently.

items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen: “I really thought that we would not win a race this year”
detailZh: 维斯塔潘：我真的以为今年我们不会赢得任何比赛
维斯塔潘承认他在 红牛 的糟糕开局后预计 2026 年将无冠，并称赞车队在赛季末期的强劲反弹

在连续八次登上领奖台进入拉斯维加斯大奖赛之际，维斯塔潘看起来像是本 decade 早期统治 F1 的力量。然而，在 3 月时，这位四次世界冠军曾准备好迎接自 2015 年以来的首次无冠赛季。
在拉斯维加斯媒体日上发言时，维斯塔潘回顾了红牛车队在2026年一级方程式赛车中进行的全面底盘和引擎大改后，即车队首次运行其内部红牛福特动力单元的中期复苏规模。
“我在前几轮比赛后是否个人期望会是这样的？当然不是，”维斯塔潘说。“我真心以为我们今年不会赢得任何一场比赛，而现在我们一直在为胜利或接近胜利而战。”
在澳大利亚、中国和日本的头三场比赛中，维斯塔潘仅获得12分——在墨尔本排名第六，在上海退赛，在铃鹿排名第八——同时公开表示小红牛22在中国由于急转弯平衡问题而“完全无法驾驶”。他连续四场比赛没有登上领奖台，在15场大奖赛中没有获得第一名，在中国、摩纳哥、英国和荷兰共遭遇四次退赛。
当被问及红牛车队的2026年复苏是否反映了其一年前的调整时，维斯塔潘立即关闭了这种比较。
“不，完全不相关。因为我们今年面临的问题和去年非常不同，”他说。 “所以，这是在提高汽车性能的同时，也解决了一些我们的问题的组合，这自然会给我们带来更多的性能。”
“这种逐步进步不仅限于空气动力学。 “在发动机方面，我们也更清楚地了解了我们想要从发动机中得到什么，”维斯塔潘指出。 “尽管如此，总是有改进的空间；我们知道这一点。这就是我们一直在努力的事情。”
“回报在秋天到来。维斯塔潘在10月4日在马来西亚打破了P1的干旱，一周后在新加坡的冲刺赛和大奖赛中也取得了胜利，并在11月1日在墨西哥城又赢得了第三个胜利。加上在圣保罗的第二名，这一波势头使他以279分排名车手锦标赛第二，比新晋冠军基米·安东内利落后111分，但比乔治·拉塞尔高出17分，同时使红牛车队在车队锦标赛中保持第三的位置。”
“向整个团队致敬；他们做得真的很棒，”维斯塔潘说。 “但现在，我们也向前看，是的，我们还在寻找我们的一些弱点和我们想要为明年改变的事情，希望使汽车变得更好。”
detailEn: Max Verstappen: “I really thought that we would not win a race this year”
Max Verstappen admits he expected a winless 2026 after Red Bull's rough start, crediting the team for a late surge
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

Heading into the Las Vegas Grand Prix on a run of eight consecutive podiums, Max Verstappen looks every bit the force who dominated Formula 1 earlier this decade. Back in March, however, the four-time world champion was braced for his first winless campaign since 2015.

Speaking during Las Vegas media day, Verstappen reflected on the scale of Red Bull Racing’s mid-season recovery during Formula 1’s sweeping 2026 chassis and engine overhaul - the team’s first year running its in-house Red Bull Ford power unit.

"Did I personally expect it to be like this after the first few rounds? For sure not," Verstappen said. "I really thought that we would not win a race this year and now we are constantly fighting for a win or close to it."

Across the first three rounds in Australia, China, and Japan, Verstappen managed just 12 points - finishing sixth in Melbourne, retiring in Shanghai, and crossing eighth at Suzuka - while publicly describing the RB22 as "completely undriveable" in China due to acute cornering balance issues. He went four races without a podium and endured 15 grands prix without P1, absorbing four retirements across China, Monaco, Great Britain, and the Netherlands.
Asked whether Red Bull’s 2026 recovery mirrored its adjustments from a year earlier, Verstappen shut down the comparison immediately.

"No, no, not related at all. Because we, this year, have very, very different problems to last year," he said. "So, it was a combination of putting more performance on the car, but at the same time also just fixing some of our problems, which automatically would give us more performance."

That step-by-step progress extended beyond aerodynamics. "Also, engine side, we understood a lot more what we wanted from the engine," Verstappen noted. "Still, there’s always room for improvement; we know that. That’s what we are constantly working on."

The payoff arrived in autumn. Verstappen broke his P1 drought on 4 October in Malaysia, swept the sprint and grand prix in Singapore a week later, and added a third victory in Mexico City on 1 November. Coupled with second place in São Paulo, the surge lifted him to second in the drivers’ championship on 279 points - 111 behind newly crowned champion Kimi Antonelli, yet 17 clear of George Russell - while keeping Red Bull third in the constructors’ fight.

"Hats off to the whole team; they’ve done a really good job," Verstappen said. "But now, we also look forward, and yeah, still look into some of the weaknesses that we have and things that we want to change for next year to hopefully make the car even better."

items.originalTitle: Fernando Alonso returns to Dakar: Why his first rally-raid experience was a shock to the system
items.summaryEn: Fernando Alonso has confirmed he will return to the Dakar Rally this winter, his first appearance since 2020, and while he still considers the project "almost impossible", he sees it as another step towards one of his remaining goals.
detailZh: 阿隆索重返达喀尔：为何他的首次拉力赛经历是一次对系统的冲击
阿隆索仍认为他的达喀尔项目“几乎不可能”，但将参加2027年赛事视为迈向自己剩余目标之一——赢得世界最艰难拉力赛——的又一步
阿隆索在拉斯维加斯重申，在他看来，F1在2030年V8引擎回归之前已抛弃了16年的纯粹赛车，与此同时，这位西班牙人继续在赛车运动巅峰之外寻求那些纯粹的挑战。
围场内此前已流传一段时间，阿隆索将在今年冬天重返达喀尔拉力赛，这将是他自2020年以来的首次，尽管这位两届F1世界冠军在正式宣布前仍与媒体打太极。
当被问及他是否真的会去参加达喀尔拉力赛时，阿隆索回答说，他认为这“几乎不可能”，尤其是因为这项挑战与F1如此不同。
如今已正式确认，阿隆索确实将驾驶一辆基于达契亚Sandrider打造、并采用阿斯顿·马丁涂装的Prodrive赛车参赛，这位西班牙人笑着说：“我没有改变我的看法（关于这几乎不可能）！我认为2027年的达喀尔将比2020年对我而言是更大的挑战。
“当时我有六个月的准备时间。我去了不同的国家测试，包括卡塔尔、纳米比亚、摩洛哥和波兰。那是一个相当广泛的计划。此外，我在沙特参加了两次拉力赛。现在我在摩洛哥只有两天时间，然后就要出发了，”阿隆索在接受Motorsport.com采访时被问及挑战的规模时说道。
“这有点短，但最终我们与Prodrive和阿斯顿一起决定，这对各方来说仍然是一次很好的经历，尤其是对我而言，因为我想赢得达喀尔的愿望不是什么秘密。这一次不可能实现，但我认为这是对未来的投资，可以积累更多里程，并更多地了解这项赛事。”
重点主要在于积累经验，而且获胜将尤其困难，这一点也反映在阿隆索对即将到来的达喀尔拉力赛的态度上。
“我认为这是我尝试过的最大挑战之一，因为缺乏准备，但我会尽量在第一周进行测试，并希望能在第二周参赛。”
据阿隆索所说，这项赛事之所以成为如此重大的挑战，是因为它与F1的许多核心内容完全相反。他第一次体验拉力赛甚至让他感到震惊。
“我记得在达喀尔测试的头几天，我晚上会头痛。我认为这来自于我不习惯的专注程度。眼睛，你四五个小时都不能眨，”他说。
“在这里，我们会在方向盘上调整设置，通过无线电通话，查看屏幕并关注比赛进程，因为一圈又一圈你始终处于同一个狭小环境里。而在达喀尔，一切都是未知的，每一米都是全新的。”
因此，阿隆索觉得自己能完全掌控赛车，但无法掌控环境条件，这与F1不同。
“我无法完全掌控接近危险时的速度，尽管我有马克·科马这样出色的领航员。当你在茫茫荒野中全油门行驶10公里后，他在远处看到一点植被或绿色的东西，他总是告诉我，只要有绿色或植被，就意味着路面颠簸，”阿隆索解释道。
“所以这类事情是我在驾驶过程中、借助他的经验学到的，但我想对其他车手来说，所有这些事情都是自然而然的，因为他们都经历过。我是在比赛进行中快速学习的过程，但作为一名车手，这对我来说非常着迷。”
总有一天，这应该会带来一场达喀尔拉力赛的胜利，这是阿隆索很乐意加入他令人印象深刻的赛车运动履历中的一项成就，但他认为在今年冬季的比赛之前，他的对手们仍然拥有显著的优势。
“我认为，以我的背景来看，挑战会比在那个环境中长大的人更大。我觉得我在2020年很有竞争力，但正如我所说，我做了充分的六个月准备。在那之前我已经积累了好几千公里的里程，而现在我没有这些。”
“我的队友塞巴斯蒂安·勒布大概是历史上最伟大的拉力赛车手。他尝试了达喀尔九次或十次，却还没有取得胜利。我完全清楚其中的难度。”
“这是一个非常巨大的挑战，但正因如此它才吸引人。正因如此它才有意思，也正因如此我才想在未来某一天努力赢得它。”
detailEn: Fernando Alonso returns to Dakar: Why his first rally-raid experience was a shock to the system
Fernando Alonso still believes his Dakar project is "almost impossible", but sees his participation in 2027 as another step towards one of his remaining goals: winning the world's toughest rally

While Fernando Alonso reiterated in Las Vegas that, in his view, Formula 1 has thrown away 16 years of pure racing before the return of V8 engines in 2030, the Spaniard continues to seek those pure challenges outside the pinnacle of motorsport as well.

It had been known in the paddock for some time that Alonso would return to the Dakar Rally this winter for the first time since 2020, although the two-time F1 world champion still played games with the media ahead of the official announcement.
Asked whether he would actually head to the Dakar, Alonso replied that he considered it “almost impossible”, particularly because the challenge is so different from F1.

Now that it has been officially confirmed that Alonso will indeed compete in a Prodrive car based on the Dacia Sandrider and featuring Aston Martin colours, the Spaniard laughs: "I didn't change my opinion [about it being almost impossible]! I think the Dakar in 2027 will be a much bigger challenge than it was for me in 2020.

"Back then I had six months of preparation. I went to different countries to test, including Qatar, Namibia, Morocco and Poland. It was quite an extensive program. Plus, I did two rallies in Saudi. Now I have two days in Morocco and off we go," Alonso said, when asked about the extent of the challenge by Motorsport.com.

"That's a bit short, but at the end of the day we decided, together with the Prodrive and with Aston, that it's still a good experience for all parties, especially for me, because there's no secret that one day I want to win Dakar. It will not be possible this time, but I think it's an investment for the future in terms of accumulating more kilometres and knowing more about the series."
The fact that the focus is primarily on gaining experience, and that winning will be particularly difficult, is also reflected in Alonso's approach to the upcoming Dakar.
"I think this is one of the biggest challenges of the ones that I have attempted because of the lack of preparation, but I will try to test in the first week and hopefully race in the second week."

According to Alonso, what makes it such a major challenge is that it is the complete opposite of much of what F1 is about. His very first experience of rally-raid racing even came as a shock to the system.

"I remember the first days when I tested in Dakar, I had a headache in the night. I think it's coming from the level of focus that I'm not used to. The eyes, you cannot blink for four or five hours," he said.

"While here, we change things on the steering wheel, we talk on the radio, we look at the screens and we follow the race, because you are in the same little environment lap after lap. In Dakar, it's into the unknown, every meter is new."
As a result, Alonso feels that he has full control of the car, but not of the conditions, unlike in F1.

"What I don't have is full control of the speed I approach dangers with, even though I have a great co-driver with Marc Coma. After you go full throttle for 10 kilometres in the middle of nothing, then in the distance he sees a little bit of vegetation or something green, and he always tells me that when there is something green or vegetation, it means a bumpy ride," Alonso explained.

"So these kind of things I'm learning while driving, thanks to his experience, but I imagine that for the other drivers, all these things come automatically because they went through all these things. I'm in a fast-learning process while I'm in the middle of the race, but that's fascinating for me as a driver."

One day, it should lead to a Dakar victory, a triumph Alonso would love to add to his impressive motorsport CV, but he believes his rivals still have a significant advantage heading into this winter's edition.

"I think, coming from my background, the challenge is going to be bigger than if you grew up in that environment. I think I was competitive [in 2020], but as I said, I had a good six months of preparation. I had a good few thousands of kilometres before that, which I don't have now.
"My team-mate Sebastien Loeb is probably the greatest rally driver in history. He tried Dakar nine or 10 times and he didn't achieve the win yet. I'm fully aware of the difficulty.
"It's a very big challenge, but that's why it's appealing. That's why it's interesting and that's why I want to, in the future, try to win it one day."

items.summaryEn: McLaren CEO Zak Brown believes Oscar Piastri's struggles in the 2026 Formula 1 season stem from high-speed corners being his strength, while the new cars require a different technique. F1's 2026 power units are more electrical, making battery management a key factor in racing.
detailZh: 2026年F1新规如何削弱了奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的“真正强项”
这位迈凯伦车手在2025年非常接近成为F1世界冠军，但2026年对他而言艰难得多。
迈凯伦CEO扎克·布朗认为，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在2026年F1赛季的挣扎源于高速弯本是他的强项——但新赛车需要不同的驾驶技术。
F1今年引入了最新的规则大改，动力单元电气化程度更高，使得电池管理在比赛中颇具争议地扮演了关键角色。
这意味着赛车不能像以前那样总是全速行驶，有时需要放慢速度，为单圈中另一段高速弯路段保留电量，这就是一个典型例子。
皮亚斯特里就是受影响的车手之一，他目前排名第七，落后迈凯伦队友兰多·诺里斯94分，本赛季未尝胜绩，仅两次登上领奖台。
这与上赛季形成对比，当时这位澳大利亚车手大部分时间占据主导，直到赛季末崩盘，最终以九场胜利排名第三，仅落后世界冠军诺里斯13分。
“我认为今年车手阵容有些变化，”布朗在本周末拉斯维加斯大奖赛上说，“有些人适应得比其他人更快。”
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦，扎克·布朗，迈凯伦
梅赛德斯是最好的例子，去年乔治·拉塞尔以169分领先队友基米·安东内利，而安东内利在2026年扭转了这一差距，成为世界冠军。
“这些赛车确实需要不同的驾驶技术，”布朗补充道。“我记得在澳大利亚的第一场比赛时，我们讨论过减速以提速。
“从历史上看，这始终是关于尽可能快地踩下油门，尽可能长时间地保持，尽可能晚地刹车。
“这些赛车需要不同的驾驶技术。看看奥斯卡，他在高速弯里非常勇敢，这是他的真正优势，而现在你有时会在无线电里听到我们牺牲其中一些弯道。”
“所以从圈速本身来看，他一直非常非常接近兰多。我认为他已经掌握了它，所以我们给了奥斯卡很多支持。
“去年他距离成为世界冠军只差一个领奖台，而在所有这些运动中，你都会进入势头。所以他处于一个很好的位置。
“我们很兴奋，想要强势结束这个赛季，并为27年做好准备。”
距离皮亚斯特里上一次夺冠——2025年荷兰大奖赛——已经过去了将近15个月，而在他于迈阿密获得第三名之后，目前正处于连续16场比赛无缘领奖台的尴尬纪录之中，与此同时诺里斯表现抢眼。
尽管这位2025年世界冠军在积分榜上排名第六，但他仍然赢下了三场大奖赛，并在两人的排位赛直接交锋中以18比8领先皮亚斯特里（包括冲刺赛），而赛季还剩三轮。
因此，皮亚斯特里仍有时间终结自己无缘领奖台和分站冠军的荒期，同时迈凯伦正试图在车队积分榜上超越红牛升至第三，目前仅落后17分。
当被问及自己在2026年剩余赛程中的目标时，皮亚斯特里表示：“我认为就是努力继续学习，这是最重要的事情。”
“这不是一个很令人兴奋的答案；我明白，但只是努力继续加深理解。我认为今年我们从赛季初试图弄清楚我需要做哪些不同的事情，到后来对需要呈现的样子有了相当好的理解。
“但真正去实现它一直很有挑战性。在过去的几场比赛中，最近五六场，确实有更多令人鼓舞的迹象。
“它并不是线性的，在这些比赛中有些表现更好，有些表现更差。
“但我认为巴西站，即使结果没有体现出来，那可能是我很长一段时间以来最好的比赛节奏。
“所以，我认为对我来说，就是要努力在此基础上继续进步。显然，作为一支车队，我们想在车队锦标赛中击败红牛。
“对我自己来说，我很想重返领奖台，或者努力争取拿下一场胜利。但最重要的是尽可能为明年做好铺垫，希望我们能在接下来这几周里实现这一点。”
detailEn: How the F1 2026 regulations neutered Oscar Piastri's "real strength"
The McLaren driver was very close to becoming F1 world champion in 2025, yet 2026 has been much more of a struggle
McLaren boss Zak Brown reckons Oscar Piastri’s struggles in the 2026 Formula 1 season stem from high-speed corners being his strength - but the new cars require a different technique.
F1 introduced its latest regulation overhaul this year with power units being more electrical, causing battery management to contentiously play a key role in the racing.
It means cars can’t always go as flat out like before, instead sometimes going slower to preserve battery for another part of a lap with high-speed corners a prime example of this.
Piastri is one driver to have suffered as he sits seventh in the standings and 94 points behind McLaren team-mate Lando Norris, enduring a winless campaign with only two podiums.
That is opposed to last season which the Australian largely dominated, until a late collapse saw him finish third with nine wins and sit just 13 points behind world champion Norris.
“I think we've seen the driver rosters get mixed up a bit this year,” said Brown at this weekend’s Las Vegas Grand Prix. “Some have adapted quicker than others.”
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Zak Brown, McLaren
Mercedes is the best example of this, as last year George Russell finished 169 points ahead of team-mate Kimi Antonelli, who overturned that gap to become world champion in 2026.
“These cars definitely take a different technique to drive,” added Brown. “I remember in the first race in Australia talking about slowing down to speed up.
“Historically it's always been about putting your foot down as quickly as possible, keeping it down as long as possible, braking as late as possible.

“These cars require a different driving technique. When you look at Oscar, he's quite brave through the high-speed corners, which is a real strength of his, and now you'll hear us on the radio sometimes compromising some of those corners.
“So he's been very, very close to Lando when you look at the lap times themselves. I think he's gotten on top of it, so we got a lot of support for Oscar.
“He was one podium away from being a world champion last year and in all these sports, you get into momentum. So he's in a good place.
“We're excited and want to finish the season strong and getting ready for '27.”
It has now been close to 15 months since Piastri’s last victory - 2025 Dutch GP - while he is on a current 16-race podiumless streak after taking third in Miami, amid Norris shining.
Although the 2025 champion is sixth in the standings, he has still won three grands prix and leads Piastri 18-8 in their qualifying head-to-head (including sprints) with three rounds left.
So there’s still time for Piastri to end his podium and win drought as McLaren attempts to beat Red Bull to third in the constructors’ standings, sitting only 17 points behind.
“I think just trying to keep learning, that's the biggest thing,” said Piastri, when asked about his aim for the rest of 2026.

“It's not a very exciting answer; I get it, but just trying to keep building understanding. I think this year we've gone from in the earlier part of the season trying to get our head around what I need to do differently, to then having a pretty good understanding of what it needs to look like.
“But then actually going and achieving it's been challenging. There's definitely been more encouraging signs in the last few races, the last five or six.
“It's not been linear, there's been some better races, there's been some worse ones among those.
“But I think Brazil, even if the result didn't show, it was probably the best race pace that I've had for a long time.
“So, I think for me just trying to keep building on that. Obviously as a team we want to beat Red Bull in the constructors' championship.

“For myself I'd love to get back on the podium or try and snag a win. But the most important thing is to try and set up next year as best as I can and hopefully, we can achieve that in these next few weeks.”

items.originalTitle: What Flavio Briatore takes from McLaren after Fernando Alonso "disaster"
items.summaryEn: Alpine team boss Flavio Briatore says his team can take inspiration from McLaren's recent recovery as it seeks to climb back from a very low point.
detailZh: 布里亚托雷在阿隆索“灾难”之后从迈凯伦身上学到什么
阿尔派车队负责人弗拉维奥·布里亚托雷认为，他的F1车队可以从极低的起点出发，走上与迈凯伦近几个赛季相似的复苏之路。
失望、内斗以及高层人员的频繁更替，构成了阿尔派“失去的十年”的特征——雷诺于2015年底收购了这支位于恩斯通的车队。
现任负责人弗拉维奥·布里亚托雷表示，阿尔派可以从迈凯伦身上获得一些启发：迈凯伦在2024年和2025年夺得车队总冠军，并在去年帮助兰多·诺里斯拿下车手总冠军。迈凯伦在2010年代经历了漫长的沉寂期，连续八个赛季未能取胜，并两次在车队积分榜上排名第九。
阿尔派在经历了几个赛季在中游徘徊后，于2025年排名垫底。目前它位列第六。
“这是‘ni’，”布里亚托雷在拉斯维加斯的国际汽联新闻发布会上被问及是否对该排名满意时说道。
“这意味着不，也意味着是，意味着中游，而且我们在赛季最后阶段丢了很多分。车队在拼搏，车手在拼搏，无论在哪里，我们都在丢很多分，因为通常我们会以第五名完赛，而这样一来，我认为我们预算的是第六名完赛。这是我们的预算，但实际上我们非常接近第五名。
“无论如何，相对于我在2024年初所拥有的，这是一个巨大的飞跃，现在车队团结在一起。工程方面、技术方面或多或少都在一起了。这又是一支赛车队了。这才是更重要的。”
“而且我们下个赛季有一个很棒的赞助商，说实话，如果你问我是否开心，是的。我不是特别满意，但车队好多了。这就是我每天看到的。”
恩斯通车队以阿尔派名义取得的唯一一场胜利是在2021年，当时埃斯特班·奥康利用第一弯的混乱抢到了赛道位置。
布里亚托利此前曾以不同名称两次执掌阿尔派车队，他于2024年6月被任命为“执行顾问”，并自去年前车队领队奥利弗·奥克斯辞职以来一直是事实上的老板。在他此前的任期内，车队三次赢得制造商冠军，并带回四个车手冠军，但一直饱受争议困扰。
自雷诺在2016赛季前收购该车队、并于2021年将其更名为阿尔派以来，管理层和工程团队的更迭速度惊人。除了埃斯特班·奥康的一次幸运胜利和2022年制造商锦标赛第四名之外，车队尚未真正挑战领先者，尽管布里亚托利的人脉为下赛季带来了古驰这一高知名度冠名赞助商。
尽管在本赛季结束前，即便是要追上排名第五的小红牛也需要一次惊人的逆转，但布里亚托雷相信领先的车队是可以被追上的。
“这是可能的，”他说。“我们在1994年做到过，在2006年、2008年、2007年也做到过。扎克[布朗，迈凯伦首席执行官]也做到过。
“我记得费尔南多[阿隆索]时期的迈凯伦，那支车队也是一团糟。他们把一切整合在了一起。你需要一点时间。当然，你需要朝着正确的方向前进，但一级方程式实际上关乎时机和车手组织。
“这不仅仅是车手的事，也不仅仅是车队的事。一切——维修区停站必须准确，策略必须正确，工程技术必须到位。赛车可以很好，车手需要完成好自己的工作，这就是我们需要具备的。”
“如果一切运转良好，我不认为这很容易，但明年落后迈凯伦两到三成（十分之一秒）已经是巨大的成功……我们用的是同一款引擎。”
迈凯伦和阿隆索在2010年代经历了一段艰难时期，其特点是组织混乱以及赛车和动力单元缺乏竞争力
很少有人会质疑用“灾难”一词来定义费尔南多·阿隆索2015年至2018年第二次效力迈凯伦的那段时期。这位两届F1世界冠军曾寄予厚望，因为本田作为引擎合作伙伴回归，但这段关系最终在相互指责中破裂。
虽然本田明显低估了打造涡轮增压混合动力单元的挑战，但当迈凯伦先后改用雷诺和梅赛德斯动力后，底盘方面的缺陷便暴露了出来。2018年臭名昭著的“Freddo-gate”事件则暴露了一种有毒的管理文化。
扎克·布朗于2016年以执行董事身份加入，随后启动了数次重组中的第一次，这些重组最终使迈凯伦重返前列竞争力。
布里亚托雷提及阿尔派此前的复苏颇为耐人寻味。1994年，作为贝纳通车队，它凭借迈克尔·舒马赫夺得车手世界冠军，但那个赛季因围绕非法牵引力控制系统的技术争议而蒙上阴影——该系统可通过车队软件中的隐藏菜单访问——此外还有一次维修区火灾，起因是有人拆除了加油系统中的过滤器以加快流速。
贝纳通家族于1997年将布里亚托雷逐出，当时车队在舒马赫离开后陷入竞争力低谷，随后雷诺在2001年收购该组织后又将他请回。那个时代带来了两个车手世界冠军和一个车队总冠军（2006年），但次年又再度从巅峰跌落。
那次低谷恰逢阿隆索离队以及轮胎供应商米其林退出F1。改用普利司通轮胎暴露了风洞中的缺陷，而一套平庸的车手阵容随后在一辆性能妥协的赛车中苦苦挣扎。
史蒂文·蒂拍摄的1994年霍根海姆赛道上贝纳通车队技师保罗·西比被火焰吞没的照片已成为经典画面。
阿隆索在2008年回归，但赛季初赛车仍相对缺乏竞争力。这引来了上层的压力，促使布里亚托雷策划了臭名昭著的新加坡大奖赛操纵事件，小尼尔森·皮奎特被指示故意撞车，引发安全车出动，这在赛道位置上让阿隆索受益。
讽刺的是，阿隆索随后凭借实力赢得了下一场比赛——在日本站——使得在新加坡操纵比赛结果变得毫无必要。当此事在次年曝光后，布里亚托雷被短暂禁止参与一级方程式。
detailEn: What Flavio Briatore takes from McLaren after Fernando Alonso "disaster"
Alpine boss Flavio Briatore believes his F1 team can chart a similar path to recovery from a very low bar as McLaren has in recent seasons
Disappointment, infighting, and a revolving door of senior personnel have characterised Alpine's ‘lost decade' after Renault acquired the Enstone-based team at the end of 2015.

Current boss Flavio Briatore says Alpine can take some inspiration from McLaren, which claimed the constructors' championship in 2024 and '25, and helped Lando Norris to the drivers' title last year. McLaren endured a long fallow period in the 2010s, going eight seasons without a win and twice finishing ninth in the constructors' standings.
Alpine finished at the bottom of the table in 2025 after several seasons of bumping around in the midfield. It is currently sixth.
"It's 'ni'," said Briatore when asked during the FIA press conference in Las Vegas whether he was satisfied with that position.

"That means no, it means yes, means in the middle, and we're losing a lot of points in the last part of the season. The team fought, the driver fought, wherever it is, we're losing a lot of points because normally we'd be finishing P5, and in this way I think it's about we budgeted into finishing P6. This was our budget, but really we are very close to P5.

"Anyway, with respect to what I have in the beginning of 2024, it's a big jump, and now the team is together. The engineering, the technical side is plus or minus together. It's a racing team again. This is what is more important.
"And we have a great sponsor for the next season, and honestly, if you ask me if I am happy, yes. I'm not fantastic, but the team is much better. This is what I see every day."
The Enstone team's only win as Alpine came in 2021, when Esteban Ocon parlayed first-corner chaos into track position

Briatore, who has run the Alpine team twice before under different incarnations, was installed as ‘Executive Advisor' in June 2024 and has been de facto boss since the resignation of former team principal Oliver Oakes last year. Under his previous tenures the team won the constructors' title three times and returned four drivers' championships, but was dogged by controversies.

Since Renault bought the team ahead of the 2016 season, rebranding it as Alpine in 2021, the rate of management and engineering churn has been remarkable. Aside from a fortuitous win for Esteban Ocon and a fourth-place finish in the constructors' championship in 2022, it has yet to seriously challenge the frontrunners although Briatore's connections have brought high-profile title sponsorship in the form of Gucci for next season.
Although it would take a remarkable turnaround even to catch fifth-placed Racing Bulls before the end of this season, Briatore believes the frontrunners can be caught.
"It's possible," he said. "We've done it in 1994, we've done it in 2006, 2008, 2007. Zak [Brown, McLaren CEO] has done it.

"I remember McLaren at the time of Fernando [Alonso], the team was a disaster as well. They put everything together. You need a little bit of time. Sure, you need to go in the right direction, but Formula 1, in effect, is timing and driver organisation.

"It's not only the driver and not only the team. Everything – the pitstops need to be correct, the strategy needs to be correct, the engineering needs to be correct. The car can be good, the driver needs to do the job, this is what we need to have.
"If everything is working well, I don't think it's easy, but next year to be two tenths, three tenths behind McLaren is already a big success… we have the same engine."
McLaren and Alonso had a torrid time in the 2010s, marked by organisational chaos and uncompetitive cars and power units

Few would argue with the choice of "disaster" to define McLaren during Fernando Alonso's second stint there from 2015 to 2018. The double F1 world champion had great expectations, given the return of Honda as engine partner, but the relationship foundered in mutual recrimination.

While Honda had clearly underestimated the challenges of creating a turbocharged hybrid power unit, when McLaren switched to Renault and then Mercedes power it exposed deficiencies on the chassis side. A toxic management culture was exposed during the infamous ‘Freddo-gate' incident of 2018.
Zak Brown, who joined as executive director in 2016, then initiated the first of several restructurings which ultimately led to McLaren returning to frontrunning form.

Briatore's references to Alpine's previous recoveries are intriguing. In 1994, as Benetton, it claimed the drivers' championship with Michael Schumacher, but the season was marred by technical controversies around illegal traction control systems accessible via a hidden menu in the team's software, and a pitlane fire caused by the removal of a filter in the refuelling system to speed up the flow.

The Benetton family ejected Briatore in 1997 as the team fell into a competitive slump after Schumacher's departure, then Renault brought him back after it acquired the organisation in 2001. That era returned two drivers' championships and a constructors' title (in 2006) before another competitive fall from grace the following year.

That slump coincided with Alonso leaving and tyre supplier Michelin quitting F1. The swap to Bridgestone tyres exposed shortcomings in the wind tunnel, and a middling driver-line-up then struggled with a compromised car.
Steven Tee's shot of Benetton mechanic Paul Seaby enveloped in flames at Hockenheim in 1994 has become iconic

Alonso returned in 2008 but the car was still relatively uncompetitive at the start of the season. This brought pressure from above, triggering Briatore to orchestrate the notorious fixing of the Singapore Grand Prix where Nelson Piquet Jr was directed to crash deliberately, bringing out a safety car which benefitted Alonso in terms of track position.

Ironically, Alonso then won the next race – in Japan – on merit, rendering the manipulation of the outcome in Singapore unnecessary. When that was exposed the following year, Briatore was briefly banned from Formula 1.
keyPointsZh: 雷诺于2015年底收购恩斯通基地的车队后，阿尔派经历了被称为“失去的十年”的低谷，其间充满失望、内斗和高层人员频繁更替。
迈凯伦在2010年代经历了长达八个赛季无胜、两次在车队积分榜排名第九的沉寂期，随后在2024年和2025年夺得车队总冠军，并在去年帮助诺里斯拿下车手总冠军。
keyPointsEn: After Renault acquired the Enstone-based team at the end of 2015, Alpine endured a 'lost decade' marked by disappointment, infighting and a revolving door of senior personnel.

McLaren went through a long fallow period in the 2010s, going eight seasons without a win and twice finishing ninth in the constructors' standings, before claiming the constructors' championship in 2024 and 2025 and helping Lando Norris to the drivers' title last year.

items.originalTitle: "It was scary at 100km/h" - F1 drivers shocked by Las Vegas 'ice rink'
items.summaryEn: Thursday practice at the Las Vegas Grand Prix was affected by rain, and drivers were concerned about how Pirelli's wet tyres would perform on the low-grip street circuit, though every driver kept it out of the barriers.
detailZh: “时速100公里时很吓人”——F1车手对拉斯维加斯“溜冰场”感到震惊
周四在F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛基本被雨水冲掉的练习赛，只是进一步证实了人们对雨胎性能的担忧
降雨影响了周四拉斯维加斯大奖赛在Strip周边低抓地力街道赛道上的运行，最大的收获不是谁最快，而是所有F1车手都让赛车远离了护墙，这一点令人印象深刻。
在巴西经历了F1今年首个真正的雨战周末、在排位赛和正赛条件下使用了全雨胎和半雨胎之后，车手们担心倍耐力的雨胎系列在没有高速弯、轮胎更难升温的赛道上会表现如何。
迈凯伦车队的兰多·诺里斯在圣保罗站后表示：“我觉得可怕的是，如果你去拉斯维加斯却无法让轮胎达到任何温度。”小红牛车手利亚姆·劳森补充道：“如果我们身处像拉斯维加斯这样的赛道又下雨，说实话，我认为我们会有麻烦。”
诺里斯和劳森没等多久，他们的预测就得到了验证。2025年拉斯维加斯只有22个雨天，因此降雨影响大奖赛的可能性微乎其微。在这座痴迷于概率的城市里，这相当于在拉斯维加斯大道两旁的任何轮盘赌桌上，押中两个数字的拆分注。
这场降水如期而至，且雨量充沛，使得周四的首次练习赛完全泡汤，甚至没有车手做出圈速，因为大多数车手都只在使用全雨胎的情况下完成了一圈探路圈，很大程度上是出于好奇。
二练则更具看点，起初使用全雨胎，随着干燥的行车线开始形成，随后换上了半雨胎。这条布满油污和胎胶、画有标线的赛道被小红牛新秀阿维德·林德布拉德形容为“溜冰场”，这也是他的拉斯维加斯首秀。车手们在每一段（stint）的头几圈尤其挣扎，他们努力将轮胎调整到合理的工作温度区间。
“这确实让我震惊，”林德布拉德说。“我们已经说过很多次，这些轮胎不好。我认为车手们去年就抱怨过雨胎在这里不起作用。它们在我们今年去的很多赛道上都不起作用。”
“但这是我坐在车里从未有过的体验。说实话，即使在低速弯以100公里/小时行驶也很可怕。四个轮子只是打滑，不知道会不会撞墙。显然，因为是街道赛道，所有那些油漆和墙壁让情况更糟。这对我来说是非常新的体验，说实话，我能联想到的最接近的情况是驾驶拉力赛车在冰面上，而不是F1赛车。”
更有经验的车手也支持林德布拉德的看法。“是的，当我看到没有撞车或什么都没发生时，我总是很惊讶，因为你自己在那里经常会有那种时刻，”威廉姆斯的亚历克斯·阿尔本说。“但这是全年最棘手的赛道，全年最低的抓地力，这些车在湿滑赛道上，打滑非常严重。”
第一次练习赛后，倍耐力决定将其全雨胎的轮胎保温毯温度从40摄氏度提高到60摄氏度，这在一定程度上帮助了初始升温，但阿尔本觉得还不够。“我认为这些轮胎太冷了。我认为我们需要更热的保温毯。我不知道为什么我们把保温毯温度设得这么低，因为我们仍然在使用它们，所以温度高一点也没什么区别，”他说。
迈凯伦车队的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里补充道：“起步时几乎不可能。即使我们换上中性胎（半雨胎），头几圈也比全雨胎更糟，而且棘手得多。所以，在那种条件下绝对不容易。”
不过并非所有人都同意，红牛车队的伊萨克·哈贾尔实际上表示他相当享受使用半雨胎的时段。“在第一节练习中，非常困难。这就是我们没怎么跑的原因。而第二节练习则相当轻松，”这位法国人说道。
“我觉得全雨胎太极端了。半雨胎运作得完美，说实话还挺好玩的。我开得很开心。”
在早期研发工作和多次湿地轮胎测试之后，轮胎供应商倍耐力计划最早于下个赛季推出更新版轮胎。
detailEn: "It was scary at 100km/h" - F1 drivers shocked by Las Vegas 'ice rink'
Thursday's largely washed-out practice at Formula 1's Las Vegas Grand Prix only further confirmed concerns over the performance of the wet tyres

With rain affecting Thursday's Las Vegas Grand Prix running on the low-grip street circuit around the Strip, the biggest takeaway was not who was fastest, but the impressive fact that every Formula 1 driver kept it out of the barriers.

Following F1's first proper wet weekend of the year in Brazil, using both the full wets and intermediates tyres in qualifying and race conditions, drivers were concerned over how Pirelli's wet weather range would work on a circuit without high-speed corners, where tyres are much harder to get up to temperature.

"I think the scary times are if you go to Vegas and you can't get any tyre temperature," McLaren's Lando Norris said after the Sao Paulo race, with Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson adding: "If we're on a track like Vegas and it rains, honestly, I think we're in trouble."

Norris and Lawson didn't have to wait long for their predictions to be put to the test. Vegas only saw 22 days of rain in 2025, making rainfall affecting the grand prix a long shot. In a city obsessed by odds, it's the equivalent of hitting a split bet on two numbers at the any roulette tables lining the Strip.

That precipitation duly arrived in copious amounts, making Thursday's first practice session a complete wash, with no drivers even logging a lap time as most of the pack restricted itself to one exploration lap on full wet tyres, largely out of curiosity.

FP2 was more action-packed, starting on the full wets before moving to intermediates as a dry line started forming. The oily, grimy track lined with paint proved an 'ice rink', as Racing Bulls rookie Arvid Lindblad described his Vegas debut. Drivers particularly struggled on their first couple of laps of a stint as they wrangled their tyres into a reasonable temperature range.

"It did shock me," Lindblad said. "We've said many times that these tyres are not good. I think the drivers already complained last year that the wet tyres didn't work here. They weren't working on a lot of tracks we went to this year.

"But this was an experience I've never had before in a car. It was honestly scary to drive even at 100 km/h in a low-speed corner. Just four wheels sliding, not knowing if you're going into a wall. Obviously it doesn't help with all the paint and walls because it's a street track. It was a very new experience for me and honestly the closest I can relate to it was driving a rally car on ice versus Formula 1."

More experienced drivers backed up Lindblad's opinion, too. "Yeah, I'm always surprised when I see no crashes or nothing, because you feel like you have those moments a lot out there yourself," said Williams' Alex Albon. "But the trickiest track of the year, lowest grip of the year, these cars in a wet track, it's a lot of sliding."

After FP1, Pirelli decided to increase the tyre blanket temperature for its full wet tyres from 40C to 60C, which somewhat helped the initial warm-up, but Albon felt it didn't go far enough. "I think these tyres are too cold. I think we need hotter blankets. I don't know why we run so cold on the blankets, because we still use them, so it doesn't make a difference if we run them a bit hotter," he said.

McLaren's Oscar Piastri added: "Pretty impossible at the start. Even when we put the inters on, for the first couple of laps it was worse than the wet and a lot more tricky. So, definitely not easy out there."

Not everyone agreed, though, as Red Bull's Isack Hadjar actually said he quite enjoyed the intermediate running. "In FP1, it was very difficult. That's why we didn't really drive. And then FP2 was fairly easy," the Frenchman said.
"I think the extreme tyre was too extreme. The intermediate was working perfectly and it was good fun, honestly. I had good fun driving around."
Following early development work and a number of wet weather tyre tests, tyre supplier Pirellis is planning to introduce updated tyres as early as next season.

items.originalTitle: George Russell impressed by "exceptionally fast" McLaren as rain delays Lando Norris' floor test
items.summaryEn: George Russell set the fastest time late in the second practice session in Las Vegas, but he believes McLaren is the team to beat, while Pierre Gasly finished just 0.071 seconds behind.
detailZh: 拉塞尔对“速度极快”的迈凯伦印象深刻，诺里斯的底板测试因雨推迟
这位梅赛德斯车手在拉斯维加斯第二节F1练习赛中做出最快圈速，但他认为迈凯伦实际上才是需要击败的车队
拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯第二节一级方程式练习赛末段突然做出最快圈速，不过阿尔派车手加斯利险些爆出大冷门击败他。
这位法国车手最终仅差0.071秒，梅赛德斯厂队因此占据计时榜首位。
然而，拉塞尔认为，这一结果并不能反映真实情况。在第二节练习的大部分时间里，无论是使用全雨胎还是半雨胎，迈凯伦都占据了速度优势，而梅赛德斯两位车手则更为挣扎。
“我觉得现实地说，我们今天可能并不是最快的，”拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯围场承认。“迈凯伦看起来异常快；勒克莱尔在某些时段看起来也非常快。我们只是把那一圈跑出来了。当时赛道处于最干的状态，而诺里斯没有跑。”
目前位列车手积分榜第三的这位车手认为，梅赛德斯仍有功课要做，尤其是雨地感觉不如两周前在圣保罗时那么好。
“我们有一些东西需要弄明白，因为上周在雨地里我们非常有竞争力，而[今天]基米和我都跟不上节奏，”他说。
好消息是，天气预报显示接下来两天应该是干燥的，尽管这也给车队带来了巨大的复杂性。这实际上把拉斯维加斯大奖赛变成了一个冲刺赛周末，在排位赛之前只有一节有代表性的练习。
“是的，会是这样。我们会在第三节练习一开始就出场，努力完成一次长距离跑。我认为没人知道周六的颗粒化会是什么样，”拉塞尔说。
“去年是一次轻松的一停，但前年有很多颗粒化，是两停。所以，有些问题我们想要得到答案，但可能要到比赛日才能得到答案。”
然而，当被 Motorsport.com 问询时，轮胎供应商倍耐力表示，它预计不会出现过度颗粒化，目前预计会是一场相对简单的一停比赛。
虽然拉塞尔把矛头指向了迈凯伦，但车队本身仍然谨慎得多。赛事高级总监兰迪·辛格表示，车队之间的实力排序仍是一个很大的问号，迈凯伦在头两节练习赛中的速度并不能让他看出太多东西。
“显然不可能就我们的速度或可能的位置得出结论：像往常一样，我们可以预期前四支车队彼此会非常接近，而今天有限的运行让预测发车顺位变得更加困难，”他说。
迈凯伦为拉斯维加斯带来了底板升级，诺里斯原本计划在周四进行测试。然而，条件不允许这样做。
迈凯伦不想冒任何风险，正如红牛选择不对其更新后的前翼冒险一样。
“这样的条件让赛车很难得到恰当评估。在湿地情况下，我们不得不把一些传感器用胶带封起来，这意味着我们并不总能获得想要的数据证据，”辛格说道。
“所以我们决定不安装新的底板，既是出于风险考虑，也是因为我们认为在这种条件下无法从中了解到太多东西。我们希望明天能装上它并进行更有效的评估。”
detailEn: George Russell impressed by "exceptionally fast" McLaren as rain delays Lando Norris' floor test
The Mercedes driver topped the timesheets in the second F1 practice session in Las Vegas, but believes McLaren was actually the team to beat

George Russell came out of nowhere to set the fastest time in the closing stages of the second Formula 1 practice session in Las Vegas, although Alpine driver Pierre Gasly almost caused a major surprise by beating him.
The Frenchman ultimately fell just 0.071 seconds short, leaving the Mercedes works team at the top of the timesheets.

According to Russell, however, that result does not reflect the true picture. For most of the second practice session, on both full wets and intermediates, McLaren set the pace, while the Mercedes duo struggled more.

"I think realistically we were probably not the fastest today," Russell admitted in the Vegas paddock. "McLaren looked exceptionally fast; Charles looked very fast at points. We just got the lap in. The track was at its driest and Norris didn't run."

The driver currently third in the world championship standings believes Mercedes still has homework to do, particularly as the feeling in the wet was not as good as it had been two weeks ago in Sao Paulo.
"We've got some things to understand because we were very competitive in the wet last week and [today] both Kimi and I were off the pace," he said.

The good news is that the weather forecasts suggest the next two days should be dry, although that also presents enormous complexity for the teams. It effectively turns the Las Vegas Grand Prix into a sprint weekend with just one representative session ahead of qualifying.
"Yeah, it will be. We'll be out from the beginning in FP3, trying to get a long run in. I think nobody knows how the graining is going to be for Saturday," Russell said.

"Last year it was an easy one-stop, but the year before there was lots of graining and it was a two-stop. So, there are questions that we want answered, but we probably won't get an answer until race day."
However, when asked by Motorsport.com, tyre supplier Pirelli indicated that it does not expect excessive graining and is currently anticipating a relatively straightforward one-stop race.

While Russell pointed to McLaren, the team itself remains much more cautious. Senior director of racing Randy Singh says the pecking order is still a major question mark, with McLaren's pace in the opening two practice sessions telling him very little.

"It is clearly impossible to draw conclusions about our pace or likely positions: as usual, we can expect that the top four teams will be very close to each other, and the limited running of today makes it even more difficult to predict what will be the starting grid," he said.
McLaren has brought a floor update to Las Vegas, which Norris was originally scheduled to test on Thursday. However, the conditions have prevented that from happening.
McLaren did not want to take any risks, just as Red Bull opted not to do with its updated front wing.
"The conditions made it difficult to evaluate the car properly. In the wet, we had to tape up some of the sensors, which meant we could not always get the evidence we wanted," Singh said.
"So we decided not to fit the new floor because of the risk and because we did not think we would learn much from it in these conditions. We hope to run it tomorrow and assess it more effectively."

detailZh: 倍耐力在F1卡塔尔大奖赛重新引入单段里程上限
F1下周末造访卢赛尔，任何车手每段都不得超过27圈
F1车队在卡塔尔大奖赛将再次为每辆赛车遵守规定的单段里程上限，以保护倍耐力轮胎应对这条高磨损赛道。
车手在卢赛尔国际赛道每段最多跑27圈，这意味着在57圈的比赛中，车队很可能选择两停策略。
这与去年的情况类似，当时在分析2024年比赛后，将每段行驶圈数限制在25圈，因为“多条轮胎，尤其是左前轮，已达到最大磨损”。2023年的赛事也受到每段圈数限制的约束，不过那一年强制限制仅为18圈。
此前车队曾尝试超过30圈的行驶段，这在拥有16个弯角、5.4公里长、包含各种类型弯道——尤其是中高速弯——的赛道上尤为具有挑战性。
倍耐力首席F1工程师西蒙·贝拉在本周末拉斯维加斯大奖赛上表示：“规则方面的限制相同，但圈数将是27圈，而非25圈。
“我们增加了两圈。从我们的室内测试中可以看出，可以说这是可接受的，没有特别的风险。”
“但我们知道卡塔尔站的问题在于局部磨损非常高，尤其是前轮，平均跑完25、26圈后磨损就很容易达到100%。
“这会给轮胎带来更大的压力，因为胎面胶料无法保护内部结构，再加上高负荷、高横向载荷，以及高温、高胎体温度。
“所以，这些因素对轮胎完整性的影响更大。”
比赛中车手完成的每一圈，包括安全车带领下的圈数，都会计入总数，任何未遵守规定的人都可能面临取消资格的处罚。
不过这并不意味着策略选择受限，因为2025年迈凯伦就选择不在第七圈安全车下进站，以保持灵活性，避免在第32圈前再次进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里和兰多·诺里斯一直坚持到该段进站窗口极限结束，但这仍然适得其反，因为这意味着两位车手都将胜利输给了红牛车队的冠军竞争对手马克斯·维斯塔潘。
尽管如此，这场大奖赛最终仍以两停为主流，并且紧随周六的19圈冲刺赛之后进行，而今年的赛事将不设冲刺赛。
贝拉补充道：“我们将保留相同的圈数限制，只是为了促成两次进站，并避免在胎面底层上跑多圈、产生完整性问题的任何风险。”
“我们知道，如果前轮磨损达到100%，其实并不会引发严重的性能衰退。
“车队在长距离运行中很容易管理前轴，如果没看到性能明显下降，他们不会进站。
“所以情况就是这样，我们会统计每节练习的圈数。今年不再是冲刺赛周末，去年才是，所以会稍微容易一些。
“因此，连圈数统计对我们来说都会更简单，我们会在周六试跑结束后复核圈数，并公布每套轮胎剩余的可用圈数。”
卡塔尔将作为2026赛季23站比赛中的倒数第二场大奖赛，阿布扎比将于12月4日至6日举办收官战。
detailEn: Pirelli reintroduces stint limit for F1 Qatar GP
F1 visits Lusail next weekend and no driver can go beyond 27 laps per stint
Formula 1 teams will again have to follow a prescribed stint limit for each car at the Qatar Grand Prix to protect the Pirelli tyres around the high-degradation track.
Drivers must complete no more than 27 laps per stint at Lusail International Circuit, meaning teams will likely opt for a two-stop strategy in the 57-lap race.

It is a similar situation to last year when stints were limited to 25 laps following analysis of the 2024 contest, where “several tyres, particularly the left front, had reached the maximum wear”. The 2023 event was also the subject of stint limits, though that year, the enforced limit was just 18 laps.
That came after teams attempted stints of over 30 laps, which is especially challenging at the 16-turn, 5.4km circuit that features various types of corners - particularly medium-to-high-speed.
Pirelli’s chief F1 engineer Simone Berra said at this weekend’s Las Vegas Grand Prix: “The same limitation in terms of rules, but the number of laps will be 27, not 25.
“We increased by two laps. We have seen from our indoor testing that this is, let's say, acceptable without any particular risk.
“But we know the issue in Qatar is that we have very high localised wear, especially on the front, with 100% wear easily reached after 25, 26 laps on average.

“This is generating higher stress on the tyre because you don't have the thread compound protecting the structure and then you have high loads, high lateral loads there, and high temperature, high carcass temperature.
“So, these are the factors that are influencing more the integrity resistance of the tyre.”
Every lap a driver completes during the race, including those behind a safety car, will count towards the total and a disqualification is the likely punishment for anybody who fails to oblige.
It doesn’t mean strategic options are limited though, as 2025 saw McLaren opt against pitting under a lap seven safety car to maintain flexibility and not have to stop again before lap 32.
Oscar Piastri and Lando Norris stayed out until the end of the stint limit, but this still backfired as it meant both drivers lost the victory to title rival Max Verstappen at Red Bull.
The grand prix ended as a predominantly two-stop contest nevertheless and it followed the 19-lap sprint race on the Saturday, which will not feature in this year’s event.
Berra added: “We are going to keep the same laps limitation just to induce the two stops and avoid any risk of running on the under-thread for multiple laps and generating integrity issues.
“We know that if you reach 100% wear on the front, then you don't really induce a big degradation.
“The teams, they can easily manage the front axle in the long runs, they don't stop if they don't see quite a significant drop in performance.
“So, that's the situation, and we will count the number of laps for each session. It will be a little bit easier because it's no more a sprint event this year, while it was last year.
“So, even the lap count will be easier for us and we will review the lap count and release the remaining laps per set at the end of Saturday running.”
Qatar will serve as the penultimate grand prix of the 23-round 2026 campaign with Abu Dhabi hosting the finale on 4-6 December.
